title: Bug Fixes
seo: SaaS bug fixing and issue triage
meta: We reproduce, fix and test bugs in your web app or SaaS, with clear updates on each one. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Bug fixes for your SaaS, with clear updates
overview: Send us your list of bugs with screenshots or steps. We reproduce each one, find the cause, fix it on a branch and test that it stays fixed. You get a plain update on every issue, a note on the cause and a regression test where it makes sense. If a bug turns out to be a bigger design problem, we say so rather than patching it badly.

list: Error log review for repeat issues

faq: One bug is one problem with one cause, for example a checkout button that fails. If two symptoms come from the same cause, we count them as one. We confirm the count with you before starting.
Can you fix bugs in code written by someone else?
Yes, that is most of what we do here. We read the surrounding code first so the fix fits the existing style and does not break nearby features.
What if you cannot reproduce a bug?
We tell you what we tried and ask for more detail, such as browser, account type or logs. If it still cannot be reproduced, we add logging so the next occurrence can be traced.
Mark an outage as top priority in the order notes and we work on it first. Round the clock cover is not part of these packages, and ongoing support is quoted separately.
